int_name: E GODFREY AVE & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area with high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing may impact safety.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crossing
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street near the intersection can obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are clearly visible, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install or upgrade pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information to crossing pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, sidewalks, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and large turning radii encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Main arterial roadway stretching into the background.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
